value.rationale: Four alternating runs are the first nontrivial binary RLE shape with two appearances of each letter and competing mixed-run rectangles. The exact constructive minimal-absent-factor set is a natural antidictionary invariant, and its cardinality exhibits a sharp 1/2/4 trichotomy (missing 3) controlled by just two comparisons. The formula provides instant count and parameter-level structure without expanding the word or enumerating factors; it is not a finite table, variable renaming, or one-coefficient increment of a previous formula.
